name: 今日の三つの学びを終える
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 460 px Japanese “today's learning” completion component. Use Reference 1 as the authoritative native preview for content, layout and proportions. References 2–4 are the exact original flame, stacked-books and timer artwork; place each unchanged in its 52 × 52 px image box. Reference 5 shows the approved white and forest-green accent treatment. Return only the component canvas, without phone frame or surrounding app page.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the canvas and mission card surfaces pure white #FFFFFF. Add no cream, mint, pale-green, blue-gray or other tinted UI fills, gradients, glows, shadows or textures. Keep the outline and row dividers neutral light gray #E4E4E4. Use solid forest green #047857 for completed check circles, the completion strip and the confirmation button. Preserve the original orange, yellow, purple and blue colors only inside the three exact supplied icon images.

Match the native 390 × 460 layout: white canvas. Heading x=16/y=16, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D, exact text “今日の学び”. Main white list card x=16/y=66, 358×246, radius 12, 1 px #E4E4E4 outline. Three rows, with exact source icon artwork at x=32, width=52, height=52: flame at y=78, stacked books at y=160, timer at y=242. Row labels x=104, width=212, 24 px line box, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #1D1D1D: y=96 “連続学習を始める”; y=178 “要約をひとつ読み終える”; y=260 “10分間学ぶ”. Put a 20×20 solid #047857 completed circle at x=336/y=96, 178, 260; center a simple white checkmark in each. Use neutral #E4E4E4 dividers x=32/y=148 and x=32/y=230, each 326×1.

Below the card, place a solid #047857 completion strip x=16/y=312, 358×30, 4 px corners, with centered white Meiryo Regular 12/16 text at x=24/y=320: “今日の三つの学びを終えました”. Place the confirmation button x=16/y=382, 358×44, 10 px corners, solid #047857; centered white Meiryo Regular 14/24 text: “確認しました”. Keep the generous 40 px gap between the strip and button.

Keep all Japanese copy exact. Do not redraw or alter the three supplied icons, and do not add any background tint, extra icon, ornament or text. Preserve crisp, compact spacing and the native alignment.
reviewNotes: No pale tint fills; typography, contain-fit icon sizes and card/strip geometry need one correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
